html:
1What the exam is

The AZ-900 exam tests foundational knowledge of cloud concepts and of Microsoft Azure. It is a common first step toward an Azure career. You do not need to build anything: you need to describe and recognize services, models and tools and pick the right one for a short scenario.

Fact Value
Time 45 minutes for the assessment
Passing score 700 or more, on a scale of 1 to 1,000
Retake 24 hours after the first attempt; later waits vary
Languages English first; other languages follow about eight weeks later
Number of questions, price, question types [Verify live] not on the pages this course was built from: confirm on the exam page. The price depends on the country or region.
Note

. A scaled score of 700 does not mean 70% of the questions. Do not try to compute a percentage; aim to understand everything in the study guide.

2The three domains and their weights

Domain Weight What it asks
Describe cloud concepts 25–30% What cloud computing is, why it is used, and the service types (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
Describe Azure architecture and services 35–40% Regions, zones, resource organization, compute, networking, storage, identity and security
Describe Azure management and governance 30–35% Cost, governance and compliance, tools for managing resources, monitoring

The middle domain is the biggest, but the other two together are more than half of the exam. Every domain matters.

3Where each domain lives in this course

Modules Domain Skills groups
1, 2, 3 Cloud concepts cloud computing; benefits; service types
4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 Architecture and services core components; compute and networking; storage; identity, access and security
11, 12, 13, 14 Management and governance cost; governance and compliance; managing and deploying resources; monitoring
15 All exam technique and a final review

4How to read the exam wording

The exam uses action words. Each one tells you the depth you need.

Word in the study guide What you must be able to do
Define Give the meaning in one sentence
Describe Explain what it is, what it is for and one key fact
Compare Tell two or more options apart and say when to pick each
Identify Pick the right option from a list (often use cases)
Explore Know what the tool shows (for example the pricing calculator)
Exam tip

. "Identify appropriate use cases" means the question gives a business need and you choose the cloud model, service type or service that fits. Learn each service with its one-line purpose.

5A repeatable way to answer a question

  1. Read the last sentence first. It tells you what is asked (which service, which model, which benefit).
  2. Underline the key need: "no servers to manage", "keep data in the country", "pay only for what you use", "control access to resources".
  3. Remove options that are clearly another category: for example a storage service in a networking question.
  4. Pick the most specific match, not the most powerful service.
  5. Mark and move on if you are stuck. 45 minutes is short; do not stay on one question.

6A study plan

Step What to do Modules
1 Learn the vocabulary of the cloud first: models, benefits, service types 1–3
2 Learn the Azure building blocks: regions, resources, compute, network, storage 4–8
3 Learn how identity and security fit together 9–10
4 Learn cost, governance, tools and monitoring 11–14
5 Review with the Quick Reference Cards and the practice questions 15

Spaced review: after each module, answer its recall questions from memory, then check. Repeat each Quick Reference Card the next day and again after a week.

7What is not on the exam

The exam is foundational. It does not ask you to write code, build a network, or configure a service step by step. Detailed portal clicks and command syntax are out of scope; this course mentions a command only to show what a tool does.

8Exam Q&A

8.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors is planning for the AZ-900 exam and wants to know which domain carries the largest weight. Which domain is it?

  • ADescribe cloud concepts
  • BDescribe Azure architecture and services
  • CDescribe Azure management and governance
  • DAll domains carry exactly the same weight
Show the answer

Answer: B. Describe Azure architecture and services is 35–40%, the largest range. Cloud concepts is 25–30% and management and governance is 30–35%.

S2A candidate scores 700 on the exam. What does that mean?

  • AThe candidate answered 70% of the questions correctly
  • BThe candidate failed and may retake the exam after 24 hours
  • CThe candidate reached the passing score on a scale of 1 to 1,000
  • DThe candidate must wait 30 days before the result is valid
Show the answer

Answer: C. 700 or more on a scale of 1 to 1,000 is a pass. The scaled score is not a percentage of correct answers.

S3A question asks you to "identify appropriate use cases" for a cloud service type. What is expected?

  • AWrite the commands that create the service
  • BRecite the full price list of the service
  • CMatch a business need to the service type or service that fits it
  • DDraw the architecture diagram from memory
Show the answer

Answer: C. Identify means to choose the right option for a described need. Commands, prices and diagrams are not what the verb asks for.

S4During the exam you reach a question you cannot answer after a minute of thought. What is the best action?

  • ASpend ten minutes on it, because every question is worth the same
  • BMark it, make your best choice, move on and return if time remains
  • CLeave the exam, because the score cannot recover
  • DAnswer every later question first and skip this one forever
Show the answer

Answer: B. The exam is 45 minutes, so time is limited. Give a best answer, mark it and return later.

8.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the AZ-900 assessment?

Show the answer

45 minutes.

R2What score passes, and on what scale?

Show the answer

700 or more on a scale of 1 to 1,000.

R3Name the three domains and their weights.

Show the answer

Cloud concepts 25–30%, Azure architecture and services 35–40%, Azure management and governance 30–35%.

R4After how long can you retake a failed exam for the first time?

Show the answer

24 hours after the first attempt.

R5Which part of the question do you read first?

Show the answer

The last sentence, because it says what is asked.

R6Does the exam ask for step-by-step configuration?

Show the answer

No. It is foundational: you describe, compare and identify.

9Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 45 minutes; pass at 700 of 1,000; retake after 24 hours; confirm question count and price on the exam page
Domains cloud concepts 25–30%; architecture and services 35–40%; management and governance 30–35%
Verbs define, describe, compare, identify, explore
Method read the last sentence, find the key need, remove other categories, pick the most specific match, mark and move on
Scope foundational: no code and no step-by-step builds
